question: Can a cold-pinned archive of the original native causal readout plus public evidence-only Bayesian context selection retain historical readout competence while the existing 7-component native+six-specialist Yggdrasil model continues accumulating new domain observations, with no reset, hidden-domain labels, post-result tuning or accepted-model modification?
scope: Yggdrasil isolated draft research branch; native source and six learned heads remain in same cumulative old model, only opt-in additional readout bank and source-bound development evidence

fixed_sources.new_source: research/contrib/chatgpt/YGG-RET01/source.py, independent seeded two-world, 2-action binary public causal shift A/B/A; no hidden regime/domain truth supplied to learner; generator and frozen seed pair fixed before implementation
fixed_sources.old_diagnostic: last 32 authenticated historical CKAD37 observed events from archived native ledger; already consumed (not held science), score archived/current/gated readout cold and after observed evidence-only returning episodes; cannot be claimed as novel generalization

algorithm.one_model: existing NativeFutureStateLearner remains sole cumulative model and undergoes all 64 revealed public interventions, original 4 JEPA heads update, last 2 future heads retained byte/weight-exact but not updated because research objective is readout retrieval and no prospective multistep targets are supplied
algorithm.readout_bank: separate immutable archived native context-readout snapshot from JEPA2-03 stored with fixed SHA; does not compete for learning or overwrite latest 7-component state
algorithm.selection: posterior probability of archive versus live native context model, initial archive weight 1/8, public witnessed transition and reward joint likelihood updated after each observation; posterior strictly clamped [1/32,31/32], no hidden task/phase identifiers, no evaluator-only scope tags, no hindsight
algorithm.query: for each 2-action event return native_live, native_archived, evidence_gated convex mixture, fixed half-mixture, random-chance and independent matched online full/window24/window32/disc95 conditional Beta controls
algorithm.return: after 64 prospective new witnessed episodes, score 32 pre-consumed authentic old episodes in known historical order; update gate from public observed outcomes only AFTER each prediction; do not update native/archived trained weights on those old cases; return diagnostics NOT unconsumed transfer
algorithm.serialization: source-anchored versioned exact original checkpoint and archived checkpoint and post-event live checkpoint; independent replay and ledger prefix/weights verification, fail on recomputed SHA tampering

qualifier.new_domain: pooled prequential new-domain late_B+return_A 2-outcome Brier: evidence-gated readout must beat live native and best fully-trained conventional Beta by at least 0.005 on BOTH seeds, and must not be worse than chance by >0.02
qualifier.historical_return: after seeing public outcomes from old historical test sequence, evidence-only gate old-readout Brier must beat still-live native by >=0.01 and trail pinned archive by <=0.03 on BOTH seeds; no archive mode flag or old-world label passed to gate
qualifier.cold_custody: archived source and frozen original trained old parameters exact; full newly trained current model old prefix retained; final cold restored replay and post-event evidence-source parity PASS; no weight/tamper/duplicate/conflict leakage; no hidden source labels; both OS independent receipts must align
qualifier.verdict: ALL frozen predicates required for DEVELOPMENT_GO; otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO. Even development-positive results are not SCIENTIFIC_PASS (old historical diagnostic and synthetic prospective source). Independent physical-world science and owner approval separate.
qualifier.stop: one fixed two-seed development pass, never choose threshold from scored data, no rerun scored samples to tune; stop early only on pre-registered resource/safety violation.

controls: live native contextual forecast unchanged except witnessed updates
frozen archived original native contextual forecast
online Beta full/window24/window32/discount95 same public view/actions/outcomes and update opportunities
fixed chance .5; gate with deliberately shuffled old likelihood (negative) using last revealed event matched count
